info.title: Complexity Analysis MCP Server
info.description: Local read-only MCP server for deterministic C# project complexity analysis, member evidence, and snapshot comparison.

x-inspectra.cliParsedTitle: ComplexityAnalysis.Mcp - local read-only MCP server for C# complexity analysis

options.name: --root
options.description: Allowed read root. Default: current directory.

options.name: --timeout-seconds
options.description: Timeout for each tool request. Default: 30.

options.name: --max-input-bytes
options.description: Aggregate bytes read per request. Default: 52428800 (50 MiB).

options.name: --max-files
options.description:
Files read per request. Default: 2000.
Transport:
Local stdio only. stdout is reserved for MCP JSON-RPC after server startup;
logs and configuration errors are written to stderr.
